messages:
Priya: Okay tiny update — we just hit 1,000,000 inference calls in a single day. :tada: :rocket:
Diego: WHAT. that's insane. where's the kombucha? :beers: :sunglasses:
Mei: I will bring kazoos and the sunset deck speakers at 5pm. short toast + one-liner wins only. :musical_note: :sunrise_over_mountains:
Carlos: ci-bot: build #4821 deployed to prod. traffic spike handled with autoscaler.
ci-bot: Deployment success: build-4821 -> prod. No rollout pauses.
ops-bot: Today metrics: peak RPS=28.6k, p95 latency=98ms, error_rate=0.02%. 1M day confirmed.
Priya: quick poll: combo for 5pm? react with emoji: :keg: for kombucha, :cake: for mini cupcakes, :coffee: for espresso shots.
Diego: :keg:
Mei: :keg:
Carlos: :cake:
Priya: sweet. i'll order 3 crates of kombucha and some cupcakes for remote folks.
Mei: remote folks: we'll ship a tiny kazoo + sticker pack. shipping poll in #logistics.
Carlos: can someone clip a 10s highlight of the infra dashboard? good meme material.
Priya: selfie time? 10s kazoo chorus then back to work. low-key. :camera_with_flash: :heart_eyes:
marketing-bot: Noted: social post draft queued. "1M calls/day — thanks to our customers and engineering team!"
Diego: also, shoutout to the batching changes last week. cut token cost by 12% which helped smooth autoscaler. :raised_hands:
Mei: proud of y'all. See you at 5pm for kombucha + kazoos. tiny, absurd, wholesome.
Priya: will post pictures in #watercooler after. bring your kazoo face. :grin:
